presentation.label: RAM Record and Playback
presentation.summary: RAM-R1 records a temporary mono take from the master mix or inputs when triggered. RAM-P1 plays that shared take using the native sample controls.
presentation.overview: RAM-R1 records a temporary mono take from the master mix or inputs when triggered. RAM-P1 plays that shared take using the native sample controls.
highlights: Select RAM-R1 or RAM-P1 and confirm with YES.
Set the recording length in sequencer steps; capture is capped at 33 seconds.
Takes play back at the level they were recorded at, and BR acts on them as on a normal sample.
usage: Select an audio track, press FUNC + SRC, choose RAM-R1 and confirm with YES. Set RLEN with A and SRCE with C.
Use MAIN to capture other playing tracks, or select an input and feed it audio. Place a trig on RAM-R1 and start the pattern.
After the take finishes, select another audio track and choose RAM-P1 through FUNC + SRC. Place a trig after recording ends, or trigger it manually.
Use RAM-P1’s TUNE, PLAY, STRT, LEN and LOOP controls to manipulate the take. STOP finalizes a partial recording; select ONESHOT to return either track to normal sample use.

controls.name: FUNC + SRC
controls.doc: Select RAM-R1 or RAM-P1 and confirm with YES.

controls.name: RAM-R1 A — RLEN
controls.doc: Set the recording length in sequencer steps; capture is capped at 33 seconds.

controls.name: RAM-R1 C — SRCE
controls.doc: Choose MAIN, IN L, IN R or IN LR.

controls.name: RAM-P1 SRC controls
controls.doc: Tune, playback direction, bit reduction, start, length, loop and level.

limitations: There is one shared mono take; MAIN and IN LR average the two channels.
A new capture replaces the old take. A record trig received while recording is ignored.
Capture is capped at 33 seconds. RAM playback is suppressed during recording and resumes on a new playback trig.

A finished take is normalized in place to full scale (×1 to ×64) over about one second after a long take; RAM-P1 plays it with a matching per-take gain, so it sounds at the recorded level. A trig with STRT inside a long take in that second can briefly play quieter until the pass reaches it.
RAM-P1 makes a take louder than 1.1.1 did: 1.1.1 played takes about 17 dB below their recorded level.
The take is discarded on power-off or project load; machine assignments and settings are saved.
This release has no public panel command to save the RAM take as a sample.
Machine Pages conflicts with DigiChain; combinations using that framework need compatibility review.

load.display: Adds 2.2% average, 3.4% worst-case of an audio block over stock (emulator)
load.conditions: Emulator: OS 1.53 on Core 2.1, 8 audio tracks triggering a full-scale sample and 8 MIDI tracks a note on every step at 120 BPM, 3,000 audio blocks timed with the MCF5441x instruction-timing model at 250 MHz, zero-wait memory. Module workload: RAM-R1 recording four steps of MAIN on T8 once a pattern, normalizing each take, and RAM-P1 playing it on T1–T7. Stock: 59.1% average, 61.8% worst block. All six mods together: 73.2% worst block on 1.53, 73.3% on 1.54. Not a hardware measurement.

hardware.summary: sumedho reports the Core 2.1 all-mods builds fully tested and working on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, for about one to two hours in total, including project save and reload and a power cycle (2026-10-14): “ok fully tested on hardware and working”.
limitations: Duration is the reporter’s range (1–2 hours) for the combined session across both OS releases; recorded as 90 minutes.
Individual test outcomes were not itemized; standalone (single-mod) hardware coverage is not claimed.
Tested SysEx: 1.53 23503ca42478c1644dea5fd296893f628eafb6662d2ce5e291bfc591f045ae4e, 1.54 257144e4a584172e470c3dde83d7ccda636eeb195b4e5ff0492b3ebc8bdfaba2; firmware was not read back from the device.

tests.summary: Runs on Core 2.1. Emulator regressions on OS 1.53 and 1.54, an emulator CPU-load comparison with stock, and Modwerk source-build parity with the native build are in TESTING.md. sumedho reports this Core 2.1 build fully tested and working on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, for about one to two hours including project save/reload and a power cycle (2026-10-14).
